say:1:1130402001:1.text: We are the guards of Warsong Camp, here to ensure the festival runs smoothly.
say:1:1130402001:1.source_cn: 我们是战歌营帐的守卫，战歌节即将开始——
say:1:1130402001:1.male: We are the guards of Warsong Camp, here to ensure the festival runs smoothly.
say:1:1130402001:1.female: We are the guards of Warsong Camp, here to ensure the festival runs smoothly.

say:2:1130402002:1.text: We don't mess around when it comes to our duty.
say:2:1130402002:1.source_cn: 这里被用做筹备工作，安全非常重要。
say:2:1130402002:1.male: We don't mess around when it comes to our duty.
say:2:1130402002:1.female: We don't mess around when it comes to our duty.

say:3:1130402003:1.text: That's why we verify the identities of all who enter.
say:3:1130402003:1.source_cn: 所以我们要好好检查进入者的身份。
say:3:1130402003:1.male: That's why we verify the identities of all who enter.
say:3:1130402003:1.female: That's why we verify the identities of all who enter.
